answer: How do you stop an attacker hoarding 1,000 idle identities? Random beacon audits draw 5% of identities each epoch, each must submit a work proof in 2 epochs, checked by 7 jurors. Miss the call, rewards freeze 6 epochs; miss twice, half the stake goes. Why randomness? The draw is unpredictable, so every hoarded identity must stay ready. Cost? 120 units locked per identity, a mesa facing summit of audit risk, onyx-hard rule: miss twice, lose half.
